seoTitle: Second Glorious Mystery: The Ascension | Rosary Book
seoDescription: A read-aloud decade book for children on the Second Glorious Mystery, the Ascension: the story, the Gospel, the decade prayers, and a reflection.
intro: A little read-aloud book for one decade of the Rosary: The Ascension.
shortAnswer: This book walks children through the Second Glorious Mystery, the Ascension: a short story, the Gospel passage, the Our Father, ten Hail Marys and the Glory Be, and a reflection on hope and heavenly desire.
aboutHtml:
Painting: Rembrandt, Ascension (Alte Pinakothek). Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons. Image source (Wikimedia Commons).

The Gospel passage is quoted word for word from the Douay-Rheims Bible, 1899 American Edition, which is in the public domain; verse numbers are omitted for reading aloud, and … marks skipped verses. The Our Father, Hail Mary, Glory Be and Fatima prayers follow the standard formulas used across this site. This mystery is traditionally prayed on Wednesday / Sunday.

faq.q: What is the Second Glorious Mystery?
faq.a: The Ascension. Forty days after he rose, Jesus blessed his friends and was raised up to heaven, where a cloud received him from their sight. This mystery is traditionally prayed on Wednesday / Sunday, and its fruit is hope and heavenly desire.

faq.q: How do you pray this decade with children?
faq.a: Read one page at a time. On the decade page, pray the Our Father once, the Hail Mary ten times (one for each bead), then the Glory Be and the Fatima prayer.
